## Change classification

- [ ] **Editorial** — typo, link, wording. Mergeable on Steward judgement.
- [ ] **Clarification** — text-only, no observed behaviour change in verifiers.
- [ ] **Clarification with verifier impact** — text-only, but conforming verifiers may produce different results on edge cases. Needs Discussion thread + 14-day window.
- [ ] **v1.x additive** — new optional field / new reason / new vector. Old verifiers must still produce correct results. Needs Discussion thread + 14-day window.
- [ ] **Breaking (v2)** — DO NOT open this PR yet. Open a Discussion first.
